name: MONOPOLY Poker
detailed_description:
Go all-in on fun and fortune! Welcome to the official MONOPOLY Poker game, the ultimate Texas Hold’em poker experience with a board game twist!

Step into a world where online poker meets property-building, and every poker hand brings you closer to building your own empire. Whether you're a seasoned poker tycoon or a newcomer eager to pass GO!, MONOPOLY Poker is your destination for fast-paced card action, big wins, and endless entertainment.

All in-game sales are final. The games are intended for an adult audience (i.e. intended for use by those 21 or older). The games do not offer "real money gambling" or an opportunity to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at "real money gambling".

► Play Poker, Win Big - Texas Holdem Style

Challenge players from around the world in exciting Texas Hold’em matches, from casual games to high-stakes tournaments. Hone your poker skills, master the art of bluffing, and climb to the top. Play Cash Games, Sit & Go Tournaments or lightning-fast Spin & Play Rounds. Get a FREE stack of poker chips every day!

► Conquer the Board, One Poker Hand at a Time

This isn’t just poker—this is MONOPOLY Poker. Play your best poker hands, roll the dice and transform your winnings into thriving properties! Upgrade famous streets and build houses and hotels to grow your empire. Discover familiar characters like MR. MONOPOLY as the dealer and Scottie the dog, who needs to find his way back home in “Scottie’s Mansion Hunt”.

► Join the MONOPOLY Poker Community

Poker is better with company! Join an in-game community of players and team up to unlock exclusive rewards. Express yourself with custom avatars, stylish stickers and enjoy a social poker experience like no other. Invite your friends, or make new ones at the table. Face off against other Poker tycoons in real-time multiplayer PvP games.

► Exclusive Events and Missions

Climb the leaderboard rankings with daily missions, special challenges and seasonal events. Every day brings new opportunities to rack up chips, earn bonuses, and snag rare collectible items. Collect cards, rings and tokens as you dominate the online poker table!

► Play Online Poker Anytime, Anywhere

With MONOPOLY Poker, the fun follows you. Play whenever and wherever you want, with seamless gameplay and quick matches designed to fit your lifestyle. Whether you’ve got a few minutes or a whole evening, there’s always a table waiting for a champion.

Don’t just pass GO, Download MONOPOLY Poker today and see if you’ve got the cards, the strategy, and the nerve to take it all. The table is set, and the stakes are high—are you ready to play?

Playing Fair - This is a Texas Holdem PvP game that plays by the rules to keep things fair.

MR MONOPOLY shuffles the cards using the best-proven methods. You won’t find any roulette or bingo-style poker here!

Monopoly Poker does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the game board, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of the board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2025 Hasbro. All rights reserved.
